Name: Hot Dog Stand Recolour
Author: emurphy42
Description:
In the words of [url=https://blog.codinghorror.com/a-tribute-to-the-windows-31-hot-dog-stand-color-scheme/]Jeff Atwood[/url]:

[quote]﻿The truly funny thing about this color scheme is that all the other Windows 3.1 color schemes are surprisingly rational, totally reasonable color schemes. And then you get to "Hot Dog Stand". Which is [i][u]utterly insane[/u][/i]. And that makes it quite possibly [b]the greatest color scheme ever devised[/b].[/quote]﻿
Anyway, this is a mod derived from [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/23044]leodolons' Create Your Own Interface Recolour[/url] ﻿for people who like yellow and red way too much.

Manifest.Name: Hot Dog Stand Recolour
Manifest.Description: Custom UI retexture based on the Windows 3.1 color scheme Hot Dog Stand.
Manifest.Author: John Peters (you know, the farmer?)
